# FACTS.md — the volatile-fact registry, rendered

**Generated from `facts/FACTS.json` by `facts/build-facts-md.mjs`. Do not edit this file; edit the JSON and re-run.** 43 records. Confidence: H verified against a fully fetched primary page in the build named by `retrieved`; M a primary-domain search snippet or a fully read secondary source; L weak; GAP not verified, value kept only as a claim to check. Volatility sets the re-verify window `scripts/verify-facts.mjs` enforces: high-volatility records must be re-retrieved within 14 days (each-session) or 180 days (term-start) of the `--as-of` date.

## The week-before ritual

1. `node scripts/verify-facts.mjs --as-of <session date> --session <N>`.
2. Re-open every high-volatility source listed as stale; if the value moved, change `value` and `statement`, move the old value into `retired_values`, and re-run the Phase 5 sweep on the pages `applies_to` names.
3. Set `retrieved` to the date you read the source. `node facts/build-facts-md.mjs`. Commit FACTS.json and FACTS.md together.

## Notes per record

- `claude-api-price-fable-5-1`: Fetched in full 2026-10-11. Cache read $0.25 (0.025x base input), cache write $12.50 (5m) / $20 (1h), batch $5 / $25. Same price for Claude Mythos 5.1 (limited availability) and Fable 5.
- `claude-api-price-opus-5-5`: Fetched in full 2026-10-11. Cheaper than Opus 5 / 4.8 / 4.7 / 4.6 / 4.5 ($5 / $25) and the retired Opus 4.1 / 4 ($15 / $75). Cache read $0.20 (0.05x), batch $2 / $10, fast mode (research preview, API only) $8 / $40.
- `claude-api-price-sonnet-5-5`: Fetched in full 2026-10-11. Cache read $0.10 (0.05x), batch $1 / $5. Sonnet 5 introductory $2 / $10 is now standard (the Sept 1, 2026 rise to $3 / $15 did not occur); Sonnet 4.6 / 4.5 / 4 remain $3 / $15.
- `claude-api-price-haiku-5-5`: Fetched in full 2026-10-11. The only current model with tiered long-context pricing; prompt length counts all input tokens including cache reads and writes, priced per request. Haiku 4.5 remains $1 / $5.
- `claude-output-input-ratio`: Fetched in full 2026-10-11: all 23 rows of the pricing table, retired models included, have output = 5x base input. The Fall 2026 class twice heard about 2x; the correction is 5x.
- `claude-cache-and-batch-pricing`: Fetched in full 2026-10-11. The Fall 2026 correction "a cache read is 10% of base input, not 5%" is itself model-specific now: 10% is the default, 5% on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, 2.5% on Fable 5.1. Multipliers stack with the batch discount and the US-only inference_geo 1.1x.
- `claude-context-window`: Fetched in full 2026-10-11 for Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5. 1M tokens is roughly 555K words on the current tokenizer; the Batch API allows up to 300K output with a beta header on most current models. A "200K context window" statement about Haiku 4.5 or an older model is history, not a defect, so no retired string is registered; the current-model claim is checked by reading, in Phase 5 and the week-before ritual.
- `claude-model-ids-and-retirements`: Both pages fetched in full 2026-10-11. Every captured model output on a served page that names Sonnet 4.5 must be re-run after 2026-11-30 (runbook section 4, step 3). Other dated rows: Haiku 4.5 active (not before 2026-10-15), Opus 4.5 active (not before 2026-11-24), Opus 4.1 and Opus 4 retired 2026-08-05 and 2026-06-15. Reliable knowledge cutoff for the four current models: June 2026.
- `claude-plans`: claude.com/pricing fetched in full 2026-10-11; the Max 20x $200 figure is on the support article "What is the Max plan?" (support.claude.com/en/articles/11049741). The runbook URL 11049744 returns 404. Free includes Sonnet and Haiku; Pro includes Opus, Sonnet and Haiku with Fable through usage credits; Max and Team Premium carry Fable at 50% of weekly limits.
- `claude-skills-format`: Fetched in full 2026-10-11. A lesson that tells Team users to flip a personal toggle is wrong: on Team and Enterprise the setting is an organization policy.
- `claude-consumer-retention`: privacy.claude.com is unreachable from the build container; values are from primary-domain search snippets plus the fully fetched anthropic.com post "Updates to our consumer terms". The default state of the toggle is a GAP: do not state one. Exceptions: flagged content up to 2 years, safety classifier scores up to 7 years, thumbs-up/down feedback keeps the whole conversation up to 5 years.
- `claude-text-watermark`: Both the news post and support.claude.com/en/articles/16266773 fetched in full 2026-10-11. Nuance: the announcement says "future Claude models" and the support article keeps a per-model table with a transition period, so do not say every Claude text output is watermarked today.
